scope: Revised representative Ready status sample (queue.ready) for style review before family expansion. Only this candidate's own mechanical, meaning, readability and accent-relationship checks are required at this stage. Family distinction (Working/Retry/Paused vs Ready), renderer integration of statusCell/compactStatus, the style-approval decision and placement at assets/ready-confirmed.png are deferred later-stage obligations recorded in request-review.json and PLAR, not rejection rules for this sample.

contract.intent: One static 16x16 Ready candidate for later assets/ready-confirmed.png. Required asymmetrical-arm check mark conveys success. Transparent background, full alpha permitted, no fixed palette. Cool blue accent relationship; Ready as representative sample is a specialist proposal, not approved style.

criteria.check: Decoded image is exactly 16x16 pixels with a single static frame (no horizontal strip, no extra canvas).
criteria.basis: Owner brief: 16x16 logical status cells and Ready is static. Consumer: succeeded maps to frames 1 and display.cell is [16,16].

criteria.check: The background is transparent: pixels outside the subject have alpha 0 and no opaque matte, box or fringe fills the cell. Partial alpha on subject pixels is permitted; binary alpha is not required.
criteria.basis: Owner brief requires transparent backgrounds; it does not restrict alpha to binary values.

criteria.check: Viewed alone, Ready visibly uses a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion; it reads as completion rather than activity, failure, pause, or the idle Start control.
criteria.basis: BRIEF.md line 9 expressly requires a check mark with asymmetrical arms conveying successful completion; stateAfter ok -> succeeded and statusVisuals.succeeded supplies Ready. No mandatory arm ratio, stroke width, backing shape, palette count or highlight recipe is imposed.
criteria.scope: This Ready candidate on its own, plus the already-existing Start vector.
